Ball1 starts at the high end of ramp1, whose low end is 0.15 m above the floor, and rolls down to touch domino1 after a 0.10 m exit gap. Domino1 then topples across a 0.18 m center spacing and touches domino2. Domino2 topples 0.18 m into the lower half of flap1, a 0.40 by 0.20 by 0.04 m, 0.30 kg hinged panel, making it swing clockwise through 65 degrees to its hard stop and knock cart1. Cart1 then slides 0.45 m along its horizontal slide and touches ball2, which rests at the high end of ramp2 with its low end 0.15 m above the floor.
